_meta.status: W2 revision for reviewer and Rai verification
_meta.readingLevel: Aim for US grade 8 or lower. Short sentences. No jargon without a plain explanation.
_meta.interpolation: Words in {braces} are filled in by the app. Never show the braces.
_meta.plurals: Keys ending in _one and _other are picked by count. Use _one when the count is exactly 1.
rules: Never call an audit flag an error on its own. Use 'Worth asking about' or 'Likely error'.
Frontend imports this file read-only. Ask ux-designer to change wording.

app.name: ClearBill
app.tagline: Understand your medical bill. You see and choose what leaves your computer.
app.startOverConfirmTitle: Start over with a new bill?
app.startOverConfirmBody: This clears the bill, the removed details and any answers from this tab. It can't take back anything already sent.
app.footerPrivacy: ClearBill reads your bill in Chrome on this computer and doesn't save it. Only text you agree to send leaves this computer.
app.footerDisclaimerShort: Not medical, legal or financial advice.

import.title: Add your medical bill
import.intro: ClearBill explains charges in plain words. First, it looks for personal details on this computer.
privacyPoints: Your bill is read here, in Chrome.
Your own bill stays on this computer.
Only the built-in sample can use cloud features, and only if you agree.
import.tabsLabel: How do you want to add your bill?
import.pasteHint: Copy the text from your bill or online statement and paste it here.
import.pdfHint: We read the text inside the PDF on this computer. Scanned PDFs with no text may not work. Try a photo instead.
import.photoHint: JPEG or PNG. Lay the page flat, in good light, with all four corners showing.
import.dropZone: Drag a file here, or choose a file
import.readingPdf: Reading the PDF on this computer…
import.readingPhoto: Reading the photo on this computer…
import.sampleNote: The sample is made up. It contains no real person's details.

deviceModel.whatItIs: Gemini Nano is an AI model that runs inside Chrome on this computer. ClearBill uses it to look for details to remove, then asks you to check the text.

unsupported.title: This browser can't run the on-device model
unsupported.body: The on-device model needs a recent version of Chrome on a desktop or laptop computer with enough memory and disk space. Phones and tablets aren't supported yet. You can still use ClearBill. It will use simple rules to find details, and you'll check them yourself.
unsupported.requirements: Use an up-to-date desktop Chrome with at least 22 GB of free disk space. You need either a graphics card with more than 4 GB of video memory or at least 16 GB of RAM and four processor cores.

unavailable.title: The on-device model isn't available right now
unavailable.body: Chrome says it can't use the model at the moment. This can happen if disk space is low or a setting is off. You can try again later, or keep going with simple rules.

downloadable.title: Download the private on-device model
downloadable.body: This is a one-time download of several gigabytes. Chrome keeps it for next time. We suggest Wi-Fi. The download starts only when you choose it.
downloadable.secondaryHint: Simple rules find numbers like phone and account numbers, but not names or diagnoses. You'll need to mark those yourself.

downloading.title: Downloading the on-device model
downloading.bodyIndeterminate: This can take several minutes. Keep this tab open.
downloading.secondaryAction: Use simple rules while I wait
downloading.secondaryHint: The download keeps going. You can switch to the model next time.

available.title: The on-device model is ready
available.body: Gemini Nano will look for your personal details and remove them on this computer. You'll check what it found.

deviceModel.downloadDone: Download complete. The model is ready.
deviceModel.rerunWithModel: Run again with the on-device model
deviceModel.rerunWithModelHint: The model can find names, places and diagnoses that simple rules miss. Your changes so far will be replaced.

redacting.title: Removing your personal details
redacting.bodyDevice: Gemini Nano is reading your bill on this computer. Nothing has been sent.
redacting.bodyRules: Simple rules are checking your bill on this computer. Nothing has been sent.

review.title: Check what we removed
review.intro: We replaced personal details with labels like [PATIENT_NAME_1]. Please read the text and fix anything we missed. ClearBill can miss things.
review.summaryNone: We didn't find any personal details. Please read the text carefully. You can add any we missed.
review.listHint: Unmark a detail to keep it in the text. Mark it again to remove it.
review.lockedTooltip: This kind of detail is always removed before anything is sent, even if you unmark it.
review.previewHint: Check that the text shows the details you meant to keep and the labels for details you removed.
review.addHint: Select words in the text, or type them below. Every match is removed.
review.addCategoryLabel: What kind of detail is it?
review.addNoMatch: We couldn't find "{text}" in the bill. Check the spelling.
review.keptAnnounce: {placeholder} will stay in the text as "{original}".
review.guardBody: A final check puts back labels for Social Security numbers, member IDs, account numbers, phone numbers, email addresses and birth dates it finds, even if you chose to keep them. Check the final text for anything we missed.
review.guardAppliedNotice_one: {count} detail you kept will still be removed, because it is always removed.
review.guardAppliedNotice_other: {count} details you kept will still be removed, because they are always removed.

PATIENT_NAME.label: Patient name
PATIENT_NAME.description: The name of the person who got care.

PERSON_NAME.label: Other person's name
PERSON_NAME.description: A family member, guarantor or other person.

PROVIDER_NAME.label: Doctor or provider name
PROVIDER_NAME.description: The doctor, nurse or other person who gave care.

FACILITY_NAME.label: Hospital or clinic name
FACILITY_NAME.description: The place where care was given.

ADDRESS.label: Address
ADDRESS.description: A street address, city or ZIP code.

SSN.label: Social Security number
SSN.description: A Social Security number, full or partial.

MEMBER_ID.label: Insurance member ID
MEMBER_ID.description: Your insurance member, policy or group number.

ACCOUNT_NUMBER.label: Account number
ACCOUNT_NUMBER.description: A billing, patient or claim account number.

DIAGNOSIS.label: Diagnosis or condition
DIAGNOSIS.description: A health condition, diagnosis or diagnosis code.

OTHER_ID.label: Other ID number
OTHER_ID.description: Any other number that could identify you.

highlight.srKept: Kept {category}: {original}. It appears as written in the text after removal.
highlight.srKeptButGuarded: You kept this {category}, but the final check removes it. The text after removal shows {placeholder}.
highlight.previewRegionLabel: Bill text after removal. {count} details removed.

consent.title: What leaves your computer
consent.intro: Here is the choice. You can change it later.
staysItems: Your original bill, file or photo
The list that links each label, like [PATIENT_NAME_1], to the detail it replaced
consent.leavesTitle: Leaves your computer only if you agree
leavesItems: The made-up sample bill text after removal, as shown here
consent.leavesWhere: Google's Gemini cloud model can check the sample and draft a letter. It can also explain charges when the on-device model isn't available.
consent.leavesSize: About {characters} characters of text after removal.
consent.notPerfect: We try to remove personal details, but we can miss some. Read the text before you agree. If there's anything you don't want to send, go back and remove it.
consent.keptOnPurpose: The sample is made up. Some details stay in the text so we can check it: charge descriptions, billing codes, service dates, amounts, and any names you chose to keep. You can go back and remove any of them.
consent.notStored: This demo uses Google's free Gemini service. Google may use the text you send to improve its products, and people at Google may read it. The sample bill is made up, so no real details are sent.
consent.agreeLabel: I've read the sample text after removal. Send it to Google's Gemini cloud model to check the sample, draft a letter, and explain charges if the on-device model isn't available.
consent.agreeButtonDisabledHint: Tick the box to agree, or choose to keep everything on this computer.
consent.declineHint: With the on-device model ready, you can read the explanation and ask questions. The cloud check and letter will be off.
consent.declineNoDevice: The on-device model isn't ready. You can read the text after removal and set up the model for explanations and questions.
consent.scope: Your choice applies to this bill only, in this tab.
consent.killSwitchNote: Cloud features are paused right now, so nothing can be sent. You can keep going on this computer.
consent.statusAgreed: You agreed to send the sample text after removal to the cloud.
consent.statusDeclined: Cloud sending is off for this bill.
consent.withdrawDone: Cloud sending is off for this bill. Text already sent can't be called back.

explain.title: Your bill, explained
explain.intro: Here is what each charge means, in plain words.
explain.noLines: We couldn't find separate charges. Here is a summary of the whole bill instead.
explain.auditOffDeclined: The check needs the cloud. You chose to keep everything on this computer.
explain.auditOffKillSwitch: The check is paused right now.

questions.title: Ask about your bill
questions.intro: Ask one question at a time. Each answer looks at your bill fresh and doesn't remember earlier questions.
questions.inputPlaceholder: For example: Why was I charged twice for lab work?
questions.inputHint: ClearBill answers your questions on this computer.
suggestions: Why is the amount I owe different from the total?
Should I ask for an itemized bill?
questions.historyEmpty: Your questions and answers will show here.
questions.deviceUnavailable: The on-device model isn't ready. Set it up to ask questions.

audit.title: Things worth checking
audit.intro: We looked for charges that people often question. These are not proof of a mistake. They are good questions to ask your provider or insurer.
audit.running: Checking your bill in the cloud…

likely_error.label: Likely error
likely_error.description: This looks like a mistake. It's worth asking about first.

worth_asking.label: Worth asking about
worth_asking.description: This may be fine, but it's worth a question.

audit.noFlags: We didn't find anything that stands out. You can still ask for an itemized bill or call your insurer.
audit.makeLetterHint: We'll draft a letter asking about the items you chose.

letter.title: Your letter
letter.intro: This is a draft. Read it and change anything you want before you send it.
letter.typeAppeal: Ask my insurer to review a claim
letter.toneNote: The letter is polite and sticks to facts. It asks questions. It doesn't make threats or legal claims.
letter.drafting: Drafting your letter in the cloud…
letter.editorLabel: Letter text, you can edit it
letter.fillDetails: Fill in my details on this computer
letter.fillDetailsHint: Puts your removed details, such as your name and account number, back into the letter. This happens only on this computer.
letter.fillDetailsOn: The removed details are filled in on this computer.
letter.placeholdersLeft_one: {count} label is left to fill in, like [ACCOUNT_NUMBER_1].
letter.placeholdersLeft_other: {count} labels are left to fill in, like [ACCOUNT_NUMBER_1].
letter.nextSteps: Before you send it: keep a copy, note the date, and ask for a reply in writing.
letter.unavailableDeclined: The letter needs the cloud. You chose to keep everything on this computer.

ON_DEVICE.label: On this device
ON_DEVICE.srLabel: Made on this device by Gemini Nano.
ON_DEVICE.tooltip: Made by Gemini Nano in Chrome on this computer. Nothing was sent.

IN_CLOUD.label: In the cloud
IN_CLOUD.srLabel: Made in the cloud by Gemini, from the text after removal.
IN_CLOUD.tooltip: Made by Gemini in the cloud using the made-up sample text you agreed to send.

LOCAL_RULES.label: Simple rules
LOCAL_RULES.srLabel: Made on this device by simple rules, not AI.
LOCAL_RULES.tooltip: Found by simple pattern rules on this computer. No AI model was used. Nothing was sent.

rulesOnly.bannerBody: Without the on-device model, simple rules look for numbers, dates, phone numbers and email addresses. They can't find names, places or diagnoses. Please mark those yourself.
rulesOnly.reviewNudge: Look for names, places and health conditions. Rules can't find these.

notABill.title: This doesn't look like a medical bill
notABill.body: ClearBill works with medical bills and insurance statements, often called an Explanation of Benefits (EOB). This text looks like something else.

longBill.title: This bill is long
longBill.body: ClearBill couldn't process this bill in sections. Edit the text and keep the charges you want explained.

cloudSampleOnly.body: In this demo, cloud features work only with the built-in sample bill. Your own bill stays on this computer. Explanations and questions need a ready on-device model.

regionUnavailable.body: Cloud features aren't available here right now. Explanations and questions need a ready on-device model.

killSwitch.bannerBody: The cloud check and letter are paused. You can still remove details. Explanations and questions need a ready on-device model.
killSwitch.auditCard: The check is paused. Please try again later.
killSwitch.letterCard: The letter is paused. Please try again later.

offline.bannerBody: You can keep removing details. With the on-device model ready, you can also read explanations and ask questions.

DEVICE_MODEL_NOT_READY.title: The on-device model isn't ready yet
DEVICE_MODEL_NOT_READY.body: This step needs the on-device model. Finish setting it up, or go back to the text after removal.

INPUT_TOO_LONG.title: This is too much text at once
INPUT_TOO_LONG.body: ClearBill couldn't process this bill in sections. Edit the text and keep the charges you want explained.

NOT_A_BILL.title: This doesn't look like a medical bill
NOT_A_BILL.body: ClearBill works with medical bills and insurance statements (EOBs). Try a different file or page.

UNSUPPORTED_INPUT.title: We can't read this file
UNSUPPORTED_INPUT.body: Please use pasted text, a PDF with selectable text, or a JPEG or PNG photo. If your PDF is a scan, take a photo of the page instead.

CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: This needs your OK first
CONSENT_REQUIRED.body: This step sends the text after removal to the cloud. You haven't agreed to that for this bill.

CLOUD_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Cloud features are unavailable
CLOUD_NOT_ALLOWED.body: The cloud check and letter are available only for the built-in sample in eligible regions.

SCHEMA_PARSE_FAILED.title: We got a jumbled answer
SCHEMA_PARSE_FAILED.body: The AI's answer didn't come back in a form we could show. This happens sometimes. Trying again usually works.

SAFETY_BLOCKED.title: We can't answer that one
SAFETY_BLOCKED.body: The AI's safety filters stopped this answer. Try asking in a different way, or about a specific charge.

QUOTA_OR_RATE_LIMIT.title: Too many requests right now
QUOTA_OR_RATE_LIMIT.body: ClearBill reached a cloud limit. Wait a minute and try again.

APP_CHECK_FAILED.title: We couldn't confirm this app is genuine
APP_CHECK_FAILED.body: A security check failed, so cloud features are blocked. Reload the page and try again.

NETWORK.title: Can't reach the internet
NETWORK.body: Check your connection and try again. Your bill is still here.

KILL_SWITCH.title: Cloud features are paused
KILL_SWITCH.body: The cloud check and letter are paused. Explanations and questions need a ready on-device model.

ABORTED.title: Stopped
ABORTED.body: You stopped this step. Nothing was sent.
ABORTED.bodyAfterSend: You stopped this step. The text after removal may already have been sent.

UNKNOWN.title: Something went wrong
UNKNOWN.body: We're not sure what happened. Try again. If it keeps happening, start over with the bill.

disclaimers.short: Not medical, legal or financial advice.
disclaimers.full: ClearBill helps you understand your bill and decide what to ask. It is not medical, legal or financial advice. AI can make mistakes, including in what it removes. Check important details with your provider, your insurer or a patient advocate.
disclaimers.audit: These flags are suggestions, not findings. Only your provider or insurer can confirm a mistake.
disclaimers.letter: This letter is a draft, not legal advice. Read it carefully before you send it.
disclaimers.redaction: ClearBill tries to remove personal details, but it can miss some. You are the final check.
disclaimers.health: If you have questions about your care or health, ask your doctor.

underTheHood.title: Under the hood
underTheHood.intro: See where each step ran: on this computer or in the cloud.
underTheHood.totalSent: Sent to the cloud so far: {characters} characters of text after removal.
underTheHood.totalSentNone: Nothing has been sent to the cloud.
underTheHood.rawNeverSent: Your original bill has not left this computer.
